name: Palworld
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Catch creatures called Pals, build and survive together in an open world. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated, with its console through RCON.
startup: bash .raptor-palworld.sh || exit 1; ./Pal/Binaries/Linux/PalServer-Linux-Shipping Pal -port={{SERVER_PORT}} -players={{MAX_PLAYERS}} -useperfthreads -NoAsyncLoadingThread -UseMultithreadForDS $([ "{{PUBLIC_LOBBY}}" = 1 ] && echo -publiclobby) ${PUBLIC_IP:+-publicip=$PUBLIC_IP} -publicport={{SERVER_PORT}} & pid=$!; while kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; do if read -r -t 2 line; then rcon -a 127.0.0.1:{{RCON_PORT}} -p "{{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}" "$line" || echo "The game's console isn't up yet. Try again in a moment."; elif [ $? -le 128 ]; then sleep 2; fi; done; wait $pid

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Palworld. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 2394010) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. Worlds and PalWorldSettings.ini are
# never replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-2394010}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The Panel's settings go into PalWorldSettings.ini at every start, by this
# script; the config itself is never replaced.
cat > .raptor-palworld.sh <<'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
# Written by the install, run at every start: puts the Panel's settings into
# PalWorldSettings.ini. The game's other settings there are yours.
set -euo pipefail
cfg=Pal/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/PalWorldSettings.ini
mkdir -p "${cfg%/*}"
if ! grep -qs '^OptionSettings=(' "$cfg"; then
    [ -f DefaultPalWorldSettings.ini ] || { echo "DefaultPalWorldSettings.ini is missing. Reinstall the server."; exit 1; }
    [ ! -s "$cfg" ] || mv "$cfg" "$cfg.unreadable"
    cp DefaultPalWorldSettings.ini "$cfg"
fi
set_opt() {
    local key=$1 val=$2
    val=${val//\\/\\\\}; val=${val//&/\\&}; val=${val//#/\\#}
    if grep -qE "^OptionSettings=.*[(,]$key=" "$cfg"; then
        sed -i -E "/^OptionSettings=/ s#([(,])$key=(\"[^\"]*\"|\([^)]*\)|[^,)]*)#\1$key=$val#" "$cfg"
    else
        sed -i -E "/^OptionSettings=/ s#\)([[:space:]]*)\$#,$key=$val)\1#" "$cfg"
    fi
}
set_opt ServerName "\"$SERVER_NAME\""
set_opt ServerDescription "\"${SERVER_DESCRIPTION:-}\""
set_opt AdminPassword "\"$ADMIN_PASSWORD\""
set_opt ServerPassword "\"${SERVER_PASSWORD:-}\""
set_opt ServerPlayerMaxNum "$MAX_PLAYERS"
set_opt PublicPort "$SERVER_PORT"
set_opt PublicIP "\"${PUBLIC_IP:-}\""
set_opt RCONEnabled True
set_opt RCONPort "$RCON_PORT"
[ -z "${CROSSPLAY_PLATFORMS:-}" ] || set_opt CrossplayPlatforms "($CROSSPLAY_PLATFORMS)"
SCRIPT
echo "Installed Palworld build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Server description
variables.description: The description players see in the server list.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password for admin commands in game, which the console also uses through RCON.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Community server
variables.description: List the server in the game's community server list.

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: The address the server list shows, when it can't find it itself.

variables.name: Crossplay platforms
variables.description: The platforms players can join from, separated by commas, from Steam, Xbox, PS5 and Mac.

variables.name: RCON port
variables.description: The port the console's RCON connection uses inside the server; it needs no allocation.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
